comment: View > Show Status Line (id 72) hides the line along the bottom edge and Fit then gives the canvas its rows, and a second press brings it back. Each state's canvases[0].visible_rect ends at the line's top while it shows and at the window's bottom edge while it is hidden. The restart is the-hidden-status-line-stays-hidden-after-a-restart.json, run after this one with --keep-settings.
